title: Make films with us
intro: We produce feature films, series, documentaries and shorts across India. Writers, producers, crew and post teams work side by side here, from the first draft to release day. If you care about the craft, there is a place for you.
reasons: Our projects go from development to release in-house, so your work actually reaches the screen.
Development, finance, production, post and distribution share one roof and talk every day.
Features, series, documentaries and short films, in several languages and locations.
We hire for talent and attitude, then hand people bigger responsibilities as they earn them.
teams: Story, script, research and creative development.
Producers, line producers, production managers, coordinators and assistant directors.
Finance, co-productions, legal, accounts and partnerships.
Cinematography, lighting, production design, costume, hair and makeup.
Editing, VFX, sound, music and colour.
Release planning, marketing, publicity, festivals and platform partnerships.
hiring: A real person reads every application. We reply within 15 working days.
Shortlisted people meet the team, in person or online.
For creative and technical roles we look at your portfolio or set a short task.
If it is a match, you get a written offer from KEMSOR Studios.
